title: Battle of the Kalka River
summary: On the Kalka River, a Mongol army under Jebe and Subutai defeated a coalition of Rus' principalities and Cumans led by two Mstislavs. The Rus' pursued a feigned retreat, were scattered, and were routed; Mstislav of Kiev's men surrendered and were slaughtered. It was the first significant Mongol engagement in Europe.

as_recorded.value: The battle was fought on May 31, 1223

where.modern_name: Kalka River, thought to be the Kalchyk, present-day Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine

importance.justification: First significant Mongol military engagement in Europe, with a decisive victory over the Rus' princes.

audience_note: Mentions the slaughter of surrendered soldiers and execution of a prince.
